name: Son Of Abish ft Yashraj Mukhate, Aishwarya Mohanraj, Nirmal Pillai & Abishek Kumar | Srushti Tawade
description:
On this episode of Son Of Abish, Aishwarya Mohanraj brings her A-Game and parents for a non PG 13 show, Yashraj Mukhate steals hearts and best one liners on a repeat watch, Abishek Kumar and Nirmal Pillai make our set into Sparta and give our sound guy a tough time mixing the episode.
Enjoy
